stem.text: The mass of a rocket-propelled truck is approximately equal to the mass of the fuel in its tank. The fuel is ignited and the truck is propelled along horizontal tracks by a constant force. The effect of air resistance is negligible.
During a test run the fuel is consumed at a constant rate.
Which statement describes the acceleration of the truck during the test run?

A.text: The acceleration of the truck decreases as the fuel is consumed.

B.text: The acceleration of the truck increases as the fuel is consumed.

C.text: The acceleration of the truck remains constant.

D.text: The acceleration of the truck is zero and the truck moves at a constant velocity.
